en: An illustrated postcard showing two soldiers, one in a white winter uniform and the other in a green military uniform, standing and conversing in a snowy forest. The soldier on the left is armed with a rifle and wears a white armband, while the soldier on the right also carries a rifle and wears a German-style helmet. There are backpacks and supplies on the ground. The postcard is bordered with a colored square pattern and contains text in Swedish and Finnish. There is handwriting at the bottom, and the card is signed 'HAGA' with the date '14/4 1918.'
